CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gsc_connection (
 id SMALLINT PRIMARY KEY CONSTRAINT ck_gsc_connection_singleton CHECK (id = 1),
 google_email VARCHAR(255),
 refresh_token TEXT NOT NULL,
 status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT ck_gsc_connection_status CHECK (status IN ('connected', 'reconnect_required')),
 connected_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 connected_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gsc_daily (
 site_url VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
 date DATE NOT NULL,
 clicks INTEGER NOT NULL,
 impressions INTEGER NOT NULL,
 position DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY (site_url, date)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gsc_site_sync (
 site_url VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY,
 backfilled_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 last_synced_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 last_data_date DATE,
 error_code VARCHAR(64)
)
